title: VEKA | World leading PVC extrusion
content: As a family-owned business from Westphalia, we have been producing PVC profile systems for windows, doors, roller shutters and sliding doors for more than 50 years. For more than 50 years we have been producing profile systems for windows, doors, roller shutters and sliding doors made of PVC. Our two brands VEKA and GEALAN make us the world market leader in the field of PVC profile systems for windows and doors. As a complementary business to our PVC products, our "Recycling & Compounds" division has been practicing sustainable recycling management and circular economy for more than 30 years. Our divisions also include VEKAPLAN sheet systems for the construction, advertising and industrial sectors, as well as outdoor products marketed under the brand "VEKA Outdoor Living Products". With an annual turnover of over 1.5 billion €, of which more than 80 % is generated abroad on 4continents, the VEKA Group is officially the world market leader in the field of PVC profile systems for windows and doors.

title: History 2004 to 2022 - World Mayor
content: | World Mayor History  2004 to 2023    Elke Kahr,  Mayor of Graz, awarded  the 2023 World Mayor Prize  **Graz Mayor from 2021 to date**  Elke Kahr, Mayor of Graz, Austria, has been awarded the 2023 World Mayor Prize for her selfless dedication to her city and its people, as city councillor and mayor. Her decision to share a large part of her salary with people in need has attracted worldwide admiration    **Commendation:** “Elke Kahr, the Mayor of Graz, is a shining example of leadership and dedication. Graz is fortunate to have such a dedicated and visionary leader.”    **From Mayor Kahr’s essay:** Personal contact with people, with the citizens of Graz, has always been the most important aspect for me, as a local politician. IN GREATER DETAIL      Ahmed Aboutaleb World Mayor 2021Ahmed Aboutaleb,  Mayor of Rotterdam, jointly awarded  the 2021 World Mayor Prize  **Rotterdam Mayor from 2009 to date**  Ahmed Aboutaleb, one of the longest-serving and most respected mayors in Europe, has led the City of Rotterdam, Netherlands, since 2009 with courage, patience and humility.
